0.why: src/Radio.cpp:257-258, gain *= clamp(getVoltage()/10.f, 0.f, 1.f) only when isConnected()

comment: The station picture, the up and down steppers and the status text are custom widgets with no ParamWidget, so they cannot be clicked for help; they are covered by Note lines. The level knob's +12dB top comes from configParam's dB display (src/Radio.cpp:155, displayBase -10, multiplier 40) and from the panel lettering drawn at src/Radio.cpp:54-55. The CV input multiplies the knob rather than adding to it, so there is no sum to clamp.
